title: Payment Processor Fee Kept Back on Web Hosting Plans Auto-Renew Refunds
content:
Refunds desk standard — processor fee on refunded auto-renew charges of Web Hosting Plans.

The auto-renew refund amount keeps back the payment processor's fee on the charge, a percentage of the line amount set by how the refunded line was paid and when it is refunded: 2.9 percent for a line paid by card and refunded after its charge date, 3.49 percent for a line paid through PayPal and refunded after its charge date, and nothing for a line refunded on its own charge date, when the payment is voided before it settles. The kept-back fee is that percentage of the refunded line's amount, rounded half up to the cent.

| Refunded line paid by | Refunded on its own charge date | Refunded after its charge date |
|---|---|---|
| card | nothing kept back | 2.9 percent of the line amount |
| PayPal | nothing kept back | 3.49 percent of the line amount |

**Worked figures (hypothetical line of USD 287.64).**

- Paid by card, refunded three days after its charge date: 2.9 percent is 8.34156, kept back USD 8.34.
- Paid through PayPal, refunded a day after its charge date: 3.49 percent is 10.038636, kept back USD 10.04.
- Either method, refunded on the charge date itself: nothing kept back.
